evidence.published_methods: Dugger et al. 2026 state that annual demographic data were collected during austral summers Nov-Jan and denote each austral summer by its starting year.

date_to_breeding_season_start_year.other_months: fail closed for the primary state reconstruction; do not infer a season from an undocumented off-window observation

banding_season_to_cohort.format: four digits YYZZ representing consecutive years, e.g. 9495
banding_season_to_cohort.cohort_start_year: YY>=90 maps to 19YY; YY<90 maps to 20YY
banding_season_to_cohort.biological_age: age in breeding season y = y - cohort_start_year

claim_boundary: Do not use calendar observation year alone for January records.
Do not extend the primary parser to February-October after behavioral rows are opened; an off-window record requires a documented provenance audit.
This alignment rule changes no movement outcome and was frozen before behavioral-row access.
